svg.font-family: IPAGothic, 'IPAexGothic', 'Noto Sans CJK JP', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif
svg.text: famicart rev G - board with edge rails for Standard PCBA (top side, gold fingers at the bottom)
Dimensions in mm. Rails are joined by mouse-bite tabs (routed, no V-cut). 2 layers, 1.2 mm, ENIG, 30 degree bevel on the gold-finger edge.
GOLD FINGERS on this edge only (60 fingers) - bevel 30 degrees
This edge must stay a free routed edge: no rail, no V-cut, no mouse bites
mouse-bite tab 5.2 mm wide: 7 holes of 0.6 mm, 0.3 mm apart,
touching the board edge line from outside (3 tabs on each side)
fiducial (3 in total): copper 1 mm, solder mask opening 2 mm,
centre 3.85 mm from the panel edges
tooling hole 2.0 mm, not plated (4 in total)
parts on this side are placed by JLCPCB
If JLCPCB adds the rails instead (Gerber without rails): please put them on the left and right edges (the two 85.7 mm edges), panel 99.6 x 85.7 mm,
not on the gold-finger edge and not on the opposite edge, although those are the longer edges.
